prompt:
Create ONE square image 1254x1254: a 2x2 sheet of four game skill-tree node icons (small notable passive upgrades) for a medieval dark-fantasy turn-based RPG. Reference 'ref-nodes.png' shows the format and finish of the other heroes' node icons: ONE painted object each, crisp clean edges, soft rim light, slightly stylised, clean and rich but not busy. Hero: the Thunder Skald (storm singer with war hammer, war drum, lightning). Match the attached Skald icons ('skald-evolve-2.png' and 'sheet.png') in family and palette: storm blue and white-blue lightning, dark iron, engraved bronze and old gold, worn brown leather. Avoid storm clouds entirely (they were overused). Keep lightning small and secondary: the OBJECT is the star. Background: fully transparent (real alpha) around every icon; NO checkerboard pattern painted in, no scenery, no square tile, no frame, no UI. Each icon is centred in its own quarter with a wide empty margin; nothing touches a quarter edge and nothing spills into a neighbour quarter. Rules for every icon: ONE clear central subject filling about 70% of its quarter, strong unique silhouette readable at 40 px, few shapes, very few sparks or droplets, no grain, no noise, no speckles, no text, no letters, no numbers, no modern objects. The four silhouettes must be clearly different from each other and no motif (drop, cloud, ring, bolt) may repeat across the four.
TOP-LEFT 'Drumroll Thunder' A: two wooden drumsticks with bronze rings and padded leather heads crossed in an X, a few tiny white-blue sparks only at the two tips. NO motion blur, NO mist, NO swirl, NO halo: crisp solid object edges only.
TOP-RIGHT 'Drumroll Thunder' B: two wooden drumsticks crossed in an X resting on a small round bronze drum-skin disc (only the top rim, seen from above), tiny white-blue sparks at the tips. NO motion blur, NO mist, NO halo: crisp solid edges.
BOTTOM-LEFT 'Rolling Hammer' A: ONE rune-marked iron war hammer with a brown leather haft, tilted mid-spin, with ONE single crisp curved pale-blue speed arc (a thin solid crescent line, not mist) behind it. NO ghost copies, NO smoke, NO halo.
BOTTOM-RIGHT 'Rolling Hammer' B: ONE rune-marked iron war hammer rolling on a short round stone wheel/millstone under its head like a rolling log, small dust puff at the bottom only, crisp solid edges. NO ghost copies, NO mist, NO halo.
